gloss: living a life of leisure; carefree retirement

definitions.gloss: living a life of leisure; carefree and self-sufficient living
definitions.explanation: A four-character compound (四字熟語) describing a relaxed, unhurried lifestyle free from worldly pressures. Typically used to describe retirement or a life of comfortable independence.

examples.japanese: {定年後|ていねんご}は{悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}の{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}りたい。
examples.english: After retirement, I want to live a leisurely life.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{田舎|いなか}で{悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}に{暮|く}らしている。
examples.english: My grandfather lives a carefree life in the countryside.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}から{離|はな}れて{悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}の{毎日|まいにち}を{過|す}ごすのが{長年|ながねん}の{夢|ゆめ}だった。
examples.english: It had been a longtime dream to leave work and spend my days in leisurely freedom.

notes:
USAGE:
A {四字熟語|よじじゅくご} (four-character idiom). Used as a な-adjective ({悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}な{生活|せいかつ}) or adverbially ({悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}に{暮|く}らす). Almost always describes a positive, enviable lifestyle. Most commonly associated with comfortable retirement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}の{生活|せいかつ} (a life of leisure)
- {悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}に{暮|く}らす (to live at leisure)
- {悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}な{老後|ろうご} (a leisurely retirement)
- {悠々自適|ゆうゆうじてき}の{日々|ひび} (days of carefree living)
